speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: So as not to delay the discussion on this historic Motion, I seek the House's agreement to have the Motion taken before the Orders of the Day.

speaker: The Deputy Leader (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: This is in view of the total number of Bills that need to be read in this House during this period of Sittings.
